cleanup_intent_path recomputes crew_home()/'cleanup'/<run>.json which reckon/crew/terminal_cleanup.py:19 cleanup_path already owns; a duplicate path helper on the prompt hook's read path is defensible only because importing the owner pulls reckon.crew.runs and the ledger the module banner forbids, and no comment records that constraint

_obligation_record_project unwraps the stored row's payload/document itself, which station_obligations.py:261 stored_document already owns, and walks crew_home()/obligations with its own glob rather than through obligation_snapshot.snapshot_dir

assert recorded["project"] == PROJECT compares the constant the same test wrote into the duty document against the value read back, so it is not independent of the input; the test as a whole still reddens at the base revision because the deferral raises CrewError there, but this assertion alone is satisfied by any resolution of the fixture's single project
